title: Always-on AI agent: what it means, with an example
description: An always-on AI agent keeps working when you are not at your computer: it runs on a machine that stays on. What that means in practice, with a real example.
keywords: what is an always on ai agent
answer: an always-on ai agent is one that keeps doing its job when you're not at your computer: it runs routines at set times, reacts when something happens in your apps, and answers your phone at any hour. that only works if the agent lives on a computer that stays on, which is why the phrase is really about where it runs, not which ai it uses.

review.by: lead agent, against dusk bot docs

og_line: what it means, with an example.
definition: an always-on ai agent is an ai that keeps working on its own schedule, on a computer that stays on, so it doesn't stop when you close your laptop.
example:
a bot has the routine "every weekday at 7:30, tell me which emails need me". on a laptop that's asleep at 7:30, nothing happens until you open it; a run missed by less than 12 hours runs once you're back. moved to [dusk cloud](/docs/dusk-cloud), the same bot runs at 7:30 sharp and the list is waiting on your phone when you wake.

the ai doing the thinking is the same in both cases. only the computer changed.

sections.md: it isn't an ai that thinks all the time. most of the day it waits, and it uses your ai plan only when a routine runs or you message it. it also isn't a different kind of model: claude, chatgpt, gemini and the rest can all power one. what makes an agent "always on" is the computer under it, which can be a spare machine at home, a server you rent, or a hosted computer like dusk cloud.

- **routine:** a job a bot does on a schedule or when something happens, without being asked again. see [scheduled ai tasks](/scheduled-ai-tasks).
- **background agent:** often used for the same idea; sometimes it only means an agent working in a tab you aren't looking at, which still stops when the computer sleeps.
- **cloud computer:** a computer someone hosts for you. it's the usual home for an always-on agent.
